title: Gudea of Sumer given temple plans in a dream

tellings.quote: King Judaea of Sumeria saying that in a dream he was given this lapis lazuli,

plain: An ancient king of Sumer named Gudea said that in a dream he was given a piece of lapis lazuli, a deep blue stone, along with plans for a temple, Michels says. He brings it up in an episode with the writer Graham Hancock, beside similar dream stories about the Egyptian pharaoh Thutmose IV and the Babylonian king Nebuchadnezzar. The point is that ancient builders said their designs came to them from somewhere beyond.
